_comment: H89 transform control. The V1 mutant of h89_control_verdict.json is applied byte for byte while the catcher only loads the tool, so it MUST ESCAPE. This spec DECLARES itself a control by its suffix: bd-mutate reports CONTROL-ESCAPED (expected) and exits 0. A CONTROL-CAUGHT here, exit 1, would mean the loader sees the mapping.
subject: the verdict-mapping mutant escapes a band member that only loads the tool

mutants.label: CONTROL ESCAPED stays ESCAPED, judged by a load-only node
